Iron Bisglycinate.timing_note: Take on empty stomach or with Vitamin C. Separate from calcium and zinc by 2+ hours.
Iron Bisglycinate.expected_effect: Ferritin should increase by 10-30 ng/mL over 3 months with consistent supplementation

Vitamin D3.timing_note: Take with a fat-containing meal for best absorption. Pair with K2 to direct calcium to bones.
Vitamin D3.expected_effect: Each 1000IU daily should raise 25(OH)D by ~10 ng/mL over 2-3 months

Vitamin K2.timing_note: Take with Vitamin D3 and a fat-containing meal. Essential if supplementing D3 above 2000IU.
Vitamin K2.expected_effect: Directs calcium to bones and teeth, preventing arterial calcification

Vitamin B12.timing_note: Take in the morning. Sublingual methylcobalamin may be better absorbed than oral cyanocobalamin.
Vitamin B12.expected_effect: B12 levels should rise within 4-8 weeks. Homocysteine may decrease.

Methylfolate.timing_note: Preferred form for MTHFR variants. Take with B12 for synergistic effect on homocysteine.
Methylfolate.expected_effect: Folate and homocysteine levels should improve within 4-8 weeks

Vitamin B6.timing_note: Take in the morning. P-5-P (pyridoxal-5-phosphate) is the active form.
Vitamin B6.expected_effect: Supports homocysteine metabolism and neurotransmitter production

Vitamin C.timing_note: Take with iron supplements to enhance absorption. Split doses through the day for best results.
Vitamin C.expected_effect: Enhances iron absorption by 2-3x. May lower uric acid and CRP.

Zinc Glycinate.timing_note: Take with food to avoid nausea. Separate from iron by 2+ hours. Long-term use may deplete copper.
Zinc Glycinate.expected_effect: Zinc levels should normalize in 4-8 weeks. May support testosterone in zinc-deficient individuals.

Magnesium Glycinate.timing_note: Take in the evening for sleep support. Glycinate form is best absorbed and least likely to cause GI issues.
Magnesium Glycinate.expected_effect: May improve sleep quality, muscle recovery, and stress resilience within 2-4 weeks

Magnesium L-Threonate.timing_note: Best form for cognitive support. Take in the evening. Crosses blood-brain barrier effectively.
Magnesium L-Threonate.expected_effect: Primarily cognitive benefits. May not raise serum magnesium as much as other forms.

Selenium.timing_note: Take with food. Do not exceed 200mcg daily from supplements. Selenomethionine form preferred.
Selenium.expected_effect: Supports thyroid hormone conversion (T4 to T3). May improve thyroid function in 2-3 months.

Calcium.timing_note: Take with food in divided doses (max 500mg at once). Always pair with D3 and K2. Separate from iron and zinc.
Calcium.expected_effect: Supports bone density. Best when combined with D3 and K2.

Omega-3.timing_note: Take with a fat-containing meal. Look for high EPA/DHA content. Refrigerate to prevent oxidation.
Omega-3.expected_effect: May reduce triglycerides by 15-30% and lower CRP over 2-3 months

CoQ10.timing_note: Take with a fat-containing meal. Ubiquinol form is better absorbed than ubiquinone. Essential if on statins.
CoQ10.expected_effect: Supports cellular energy production. Replenishes CoQ10 depleted by statins.

Creatine Monohydrate.timing_note: Take daily with water. No need to cycle. May slightly elevate creatinine on blood tests (not harmful).
Creatine Monohydrate.expected_effect: Creatinine may rise 10-20% due to increased creatine metabolism. This is not kidney damage.

Ashwagandha.timing_note: Take with food. KSM-66 or Sensoril extracts are best studied. May take 4-8 weeks for full effects.
Ashwagandha.expected_effect: May reduce cortisol by 20-30%, mildly increase testosterone, and support thyroid function

Curcumin.timing_note: Take with black pepper (piperine) or as a liposomal form to improve bioavailability by up to 2000%.
Curcumin.expected_effect: May reduce CRP and inflammatory markers over 4-8 weeks

NAC.timing_note: Take on an empty stomach, 30 minutes before meals. May support liver detoxification and glutathione production.
NAC.expected_effect: May support liver enzymes and lower homocysteine over 2-3 months

Alpha Lipoic Acid.timing_note: Take on an empty stomach. R-lipoic acid form may be more bioavailable.
Alpha Lipoic Acid.expected_effect: May improve insulin sensitivity and lower fasting glucose over 2-3 months

DHEA.timing_note: Take in the morning to mimic natural cortisol rhythm. Start with low dose. Monitor levels regularly.
DHEA.expected_effect: DHEA-S levels should rise. May also increase testosterone and estradiol.

Berberine.timing_note: Take with meals, 2-3 times daily. Can cause GI discomfort. May interact with medications.
Berberine.expected_effect: May lower fasting glucose by 10-20 mg/dL and reduce LDL/triglycerides over 2-3 months

Quercetin.timing_note: Take with meals. Often paired with bromelain for enhanced absorption.
Quercetin.expected_effect: May reduce uric acid and CRP levels. Supports immune function.

Melatonin.timing_note: Take 30-60 minutes before bed. Start with lowest dose. Higher is not better.
Melatonin.expected_effect: Improves sleep onset latency. May affect HRV and recovery scores positively.

L-Theanine.timing_note: Take in the morning with caffeine for focused calm, or in the evening for relaxation.
L-Theanine.expected_effect: Promotes alpha brain waves. May improve sleep quality and reduce anxiety.

Boron.timing_note: Take with food. Small but effective mineral for hormonal support.
Boron.expected_effect: May increase free testosterone and reduce SHBG. Supports Vitamin D metabolism.

Collagen Peptides.timing_note: Take on an empty stomach or mix into coffee/smoothie. Vitamin C enhances collagen synthesis.
Collagen Peptides.expected_effect: Supports joint, skin, and gut health. Benefits typically seen after 4-8 weeks.

DIM.timing_note: Take with food. Supports healthy estrogen metabolism.
DIM.expected_effect: May help balance estrogen metabolism. Useful for men with elevated estradiol.

Probiotics.timing_note: Take on an empty stomach or with a light meal. Look for multi-strain formulas with 10+ billion CFU.
Probiotics.expected_effect: Supports gut health and may reduce systemic inflammation markers over 4-8 weeks.
